scientific_integrity: Claims are from a direct deterministic mathematical construction; no independent mathematical audit or source-wide historical novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: For each integer period the symmetric open finite-union confidence set is specially constructed. Local, not global, attraction is proved; period spectra of a single fixed confidence set and the full geometry of attractors are not classified. Finite verification through period 40 supplements, not replaces, the all-period proof.
title: Arbitrarily long attracting opinion cycles with only three agents
